port.label: Zone port
port.description: UDP port for this sync zone. This is not a device address -- it identifies a group of WLED devices, not one specific device. On each WLED device you want in this zone, set the matching port under Usermods > Audio Reactive > Sync Settings > 'UDP Sound Sync Port', and enable 'Receive'. Use a different port for each independent zone (e.g. 11988, 11989, ...) so they don't interfere with each other.

latency_ms.label: Sync latency (ms)
latency_ms.description: Milliseconds to send audio-sync packets ahead of the audio, to offset the grouped speaker's own output latency (usually the dominant delay on a LAN, far more than network transit time). Increase if the lights lag the music, decrease if they run ahead of it.

gain_db.label: Gain (dB)
gain_db.description: Boosts the loudness/spectrum/peak values before sending, since the analysis is calibrated against a theoretical full-scale signal that typical program material -- especially a loudness-normalized radio stream -- rarely gets close to. Increase if the WLED effect looks dim or flat and never reaches full brightness/range; decrease if it's pinned at maximum.

scaling_mode.label: Scaling mode
scaling_mode.description: Perceptual curve applied to loudness/spectrum values before sending, matching WLED's own built-in FFT scaling options. Square Root: balanced, a good default. Linear: highest contrast between quiet and loud, easily saturates. Logarithmic: gentlest, lifts quiet content the most. There's no single correct choice -- it depends on the music and the effect you're driving, same as picking a mode on a real WLED device.

manifest.description: Drive WLED's built-in audio-reactive effects from music played by Music Assistant.
